Microsoft.title: Microsoft’s AI future has fewer jobs
Microsoft.titleEn: Microsoft’s AI future has fewer jobs
Microsoft.summary:
This week’s voluntary exit offer arrived just months after Microsoft laid off 4,800 employees , cuts that impacted its Xbox and commercial sales teams the most.
How Nadella handles that transition will define his legacy as much as the growth and success he’s achieved over the past decade.
“Our total people costs will go down, our cost per head will go up, and my GPU per researcher will go up,” Nadella said on a podcast almost two years ago, responding to a question about AI’s impact on headcount.
summaryLinesEn: This week’s voluntary exit offer arrived just months after Microsoft laid off 4,800 employees , cuts that impacted its Xbox and commercial sales teams the most.
How Nadella handles that transition will define his legacy as much as the growth and success he’s achieved over the past decade.

“Our total people costs will go down, our cost per head will go up, and my GPU per researcher will go up,” Nadella said on a podcast almost two years ago, responding to a question about AI’s impact on headcount.
summaryLinesKo: 이번 주 자발적 퇴직 제안은 Microsoft가 4,800명의 직원을 해고한 지 불과 몇 달 만에 이루어졌으며, 이는 Xbox 및 상업 판매 팀에 가장 큰 영향을 미쳤음
Nadella가 이러한 전환을 처리하는 방법은 그가 지난 10년 동안 달성한 성장과 성공만큼이나 그의 유산을 정의할 것임
Nadella는 거의 2년 전 팟캐스트에서 AI가 인원 수에 미치는 영향에 대한 질문에 답하면서 "총 인력 비용은 줄어들고, 1인당 비용은 올라가고, 연구원당 GPU는 올라갈 것임" · 라고 말함

Microsoft.title: Build, test and optimize faster: Arm and GitHub accelerate agentic AI development
Microsoft.titleEn: Build, test and optimize faster: Arm and GitHub accelerate agentic AI development
Microsoft.titleKo: 보다 빠르게 구축, 테스트 및 최적화 · Arm과 GitHub가 에이전트 AI 개발을 가속화함
Microsoft.summary:
GitHub Copilot CLI provides AI-assisted development on native Arm compute, enabling developers to direct agents to make code changes, execute project commands, and investigate test failures in the target environment.
Develop and iterate natively: Use GitHub Copilot CLI to edit code, build, test, and investigate failures directly within that Arm-native environment, reducing the need to switch between architectures during development.
Arm Total Design for Physical AI brings silicon, software, safety, security, validation, and more into one collaborative ecosystem to help build, validate, and scale full-stack solutions on Arm.

summaryLinesKo: GitHub Copilot CLI는 기본 Arm 컴퓨팅에서 AI 지원 개발을 제공하므로 개발자는 에이전트에 지시하여 코드를 변경하고, 프로젝트 명령을 실행하고, 대상 환경에서 테스트 실패를 조사할 수 있음
기본적으로 개발 및 반복 · GitHub Copilot CLI를 사용하여 Arm 기본 환경 내에서 직접 코드를 편집하고, 빌드하고, 테스트하고, 오류를 조사하여 개발 중에 아키텍처 간 전환의 필요성을 줄임
물리적 AI를 위한 Arm Total Design은 실리콘, 소프트웨어, 안전, 보안, 검증 등을 하나의 협업 생태계로 통합하여 Arm에서 풀 스택 솔루션을 구축, 검증 및 확장하는 데 도움을 줌

Microsoft.title: Thin, Light and Built for Everything: NVIDIA RTX Spark Windows Laptops Gain New Models, Agent Tools and Games
Microsoft.titleEn: Thin, Light and Built for Everything: NVIDIA RTX Spark Windows Laptops Gain New Models, Agent Tools and Games
Microsoft.titleKo: 얇고 가벼우며 모든 것을 위한 설계 · NVIDIA RTX Spark Windows 노트북에 새로운 모델, 에이전트 도구 및 게임 제공
Microsoft.summary:
RTX Spark laptops are available now from ASUS, Dell, HP, Lenovo, Microsoft and MSI, starting at $2,599, with 128GB configurations on shelves.
Turn Recorded Audio Into Useful Information With NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Transcribe Introduced today, NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Transcribe is a new, open weight speech model that turns recorded conversations into useful information.
The update also adds DLSS 5 with 3D-Guided Neural Rendering, up to 6x Multi Frame Generation, native RTX Spark support and agent-assisted workflows.
summaryLinesEn: RTX Spark laptops are available now from ASUS, Dell, HP, Lenovo, Microsoft and MSI, starting at $2,599, with 128GB configurations on shelves.

The update also adds DLSS 5 with 3D-Guided Neural Rendering, up to 6x Multi Frame Generation, native RTX Spark support and agent-assisted workflows.
summaryLinesKo: RTX Spark 노트북은 현재 ASUS, Dell, HP, Lenovo, Microsoft 및 MSI에서 128GB 구성으로 2,599달러부터 구입할 수 있음
NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Transcribe를 사용하여 녹음된 오디오를 유용한 정보로 전환 오늘 출시된 NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Transcribe는 녹음된 대화를 유용한 정보로 바꾸는 새로운 개방형 음성 모델임

And building your own harness or model router to keep up can be painful and slow.
Oct 28, 2026 | Tina Schuchman CVP, Foundry and Vladimir Fedorov, CTO, GitHub If you want to compete, you need to be multi-model.

Microsoft.summary:
After the company let go 1,600 of the division’s employees in June, GeekWire reported that additional layoffs were expected.
Microsoft will also provide stock vesting for six to 12 months, continued healthcare coverage for a limited amount of time and outplacement support.
Microsoft’s revenue grew 18% year-over-year in the three months ended June, to $90.01 billion, while its adjusted earnings of $4.74 per share topped the consensus estimate by more than 12%.

NVIDIA.title: NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Transcribe and Granary v2: Intelligent Multilingual Transcription You Can Prompt and Adapt
NVIDIA.titleEn: NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Transcribe and Granary v2: Intelligent Multilingual Transcription You Can Prompt and Adapt
NVIDIA.titleKo: NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Transcribe 및 Granary v2: 프롬프트하고 적응할 수 있는 지능형 다국어 전사
NVIDIA.summary:
NVIDIA models hold the top two spots on David AI’s multilingual diarization leaderboard : Nemotron 3.5 Transcribe posts the lowest overall diarization error rate (DER), 18.26% across 21 languages, followed by Nemotron 3 Diarization at 18.38%.
Granary v2’s multilingual data (available on Hugging Face and ModelScope ) and reusable curation pipeline, together with NeMo Speech fine-tuning tools , extend prompt-level control to training: developers can define the written form they need and adapt the model to the speech their applications encounter.
On AA-AgentTalk, the held-out voice-agent speech set that makes up 50% of the AA-WER index, Transcribe scores 1.8% WER, versus 2.3% for the next-best open-weight model.

Granary v2의 다국어 데이터(Hugging Face 및 ModelScope에서 사용 가능) 및 재사용 가능한 큐레이션 파이프라인은 NeMo Speech 미세 조정 도구와 함께 교육에 대한 프롬프트 수준 제어를 확장함 · 개발자는 필요한 서면 형식을 정의하고 애플리케이션에서 접하는 음성에 모델을 적용할 수 있음
AA-WER 지수의 50%를 구성하는 보류 음성 에이전트 음성 세트인 AA-AgentTalk에서 Transcribe는 1.8%의 WER 점수를 얻은 반면 차선책 개방형 가중치 모델의 경우 2.3%를 기록함

NVIDIA.title: Thin, Light and Built for Everything: NVIDIA RTX Spark Windows Laptops Gain New Models, Agent Tools and Games
NVIDIA.titleEn: Thin, Light and Built for Everything: NVIDIA RTX Spark Windows Laptops Gain New Models, Agent Tools and Games
NVIDIA.titleKo: 얇고 가벼우며 모든 것을 위한 설계 · NVIDIA RTX Spark Windows 노트북에 새로운 모델, 에이전트 도구 및 게임 제공
NVIDIA.summary:
RTX Spark laptops are available now from ASUS, Dell, HP, Lenovo, Microsoft and MSI, starting at $2,599, with 128GB configurations on shelves.
Turn Recorded Audio Into Useful Information With NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Transcribe Introduced today, NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Transcribe is a new, open weight speech model that turns recorded conversations into useful information.
The update also adds DLSS 5 with 3D-Guided Neural Rendering, up to 6x Multi Frame Generation, native RTX Spark support and agent-assisted workflows.

NVIDIA.title: Oracle, in effort to reduce reliance on Nvidia, adds AI chips from Google, Cerebras, and SambaNova
NVIDIA.titleEn: Oracle, in effort to reduce reliance on Nvidia, adds AI chips from Google, Cerebras, and SambaNova
NVIDIA.titleKo: Oracle은 Nvidia에 대한 의존도를 줄이기 위해 Google, Cerebras 및 SambaNova의 AI 칩을 추가함
NVIDIA.summary:
Cerebras's massive chips will provide AI inference capacity and AI agent processing power, while SambaNova's SN50 processor will handle agentic inference.
Oracle said its decision to bring on Google, Cerebras, and SambaNova's processors provides its customers with the right infrastructure for their particular needs.
Nvidia has previously said it generates roughly half of its revenue from hyperscalers, making Google's move and Amazon's potential efforts of particular concern for the company.

오라클은 Google, Cerebras 및 SambaNova의 프로세서를 도입하기로 한 결정이 고객의 특정 요구에 맞는 인프라를 제공한다고 말함

NVIDIA.title: How AI Is Changing the Pace of Discovery for Millions Living With Dementia
NVIDIA.titleEn: How AI Is Changing the Pace of Discovery for Millions Living With Dementia
NVIDIA.titleKo: AI가 치매를 앓고 있는 수백만 명의 발견 속도를 어떻게 변화시키는가
NVIDIA.summary:
There are 57 million people worldwide living with dementia today.
To explore how AI and accelerated computing can advance Alzheimer’s research while navigating its technical demands, C-BRAIN is working with NVIDIA to incorporate technologies including the NVIDIA BioNeMo open developer platform and the MONAI framework for C-BRAIN’s research pipelines.
The bottlenecks are not enough high impact scientific findings, too much data living in institutional silos and too slow a pace of synthesis to keep up with the research that is published.
summaryLinesEn: There are 57 million people worldwide living with dementia today.

To explore how AI and accelerated computing can advance Alzheimer’s research while navigating its technical demands, C-BRAIN is working with NVIDIA to incorporate technologies including the NVIDIA BioNeMo open developer platform and the MONAI framework for C-BRAIN’s research pipelines.
The bottlenecks are not enough high impact scientific findings, too much data living in institutional silos and too slow a pace of synthesis to keep up with the research that is published.
summaryLinesKo: 오늘날 전 세계적으로 5,700만 명이 치매를 앓고 있음
C-BRAIN은 AI와 가속 컴퓨팅이 알츠하이머 연구를 발전시키는 동시에 기술적 요구 사항을 충족할 수 있는 방법을 탐색하기 위해 NVIDIA와 협력하여 C-BRAIN의 연구 파이프라인을 위한 NVIDIA BioNeMo 개방형 개발자 플랫폼 및 MONAI 프레임워크를 포함한 기술을 통합하고 있음
병목 현상은 영향력이 큰 과학적 연구 결과가 충분하지 않고, 기관의 사일로에 너무 많은 데이터가 존재하며, 발표된 연구를 따라잡기에는 너무 느린 합성 속도로 인해 발생함

NVIDIA.title: Nvidia, AMD to invest $4 billion in Meta as tech giants deepen AI partnership
NVIDIA.titleEn: Nvidia, AMD to invest $4 billion in Meta as tech giants deepen AI partnership
NVIDIA.titleKo: Nvidia, AMD, 거대 기술 기업들이 AI 파트너십을 심화함에 따라 Meta에 40억 달러 투자
NVIDIA.summary:
Nvidia and AMD have said they will invest $3 billion and $1 billion, respectively, in Meta.
Nvidia announced its investment on Tuesday, adding that Meta would expand Vera Rubin and Vera CPU deployment, and that the two companies would deepen their partnership on Muse, the social media giant's AI agent that launched last month.
Meta on Monday announced plans to raise a total of $95 billion to support its investments in artificial intelligence infrastructure.
summaryLinesEn: Nvidia and AMD have said they will invest $3 billion and $1 billion, respectively, in Meta.

Nvidia announced its investment on Tuesday, adding that Meta would expand Vera Rubin and Vera CPU deployment, and that the two companies would deepen their partnership on Muse, the social media giant's AI agent that launched last month.
Meta on Monday announced plans to raise a total of $95 billion to support its investments in artificial intelligence infrastructure.
summaryLinesKo: 엔비디아와 AMD는 메타에 각각 30억 달러와 10억 달러를 투자하겠다고 밝힘
Nvidia는 화요일에 투자를 발표하면서 Meta가 Vera Rubin 및 Vera CPU 배포를 확대할 것이며 두 회사가 지난달 출시된 소셜 미디어 거대 기업의 AI 에이전트인 Muse에 대한 파트너십을 심화할 것이라고 덧붙였음
메타는 월요일 인공지능 인프라에 대한 투자를 지원하기 위해 총 950억 달러를 모금할 계획을 발표함

Apple.titleKo: AnySpeechRecognizer 및 AnyDecisionModel 소개 · Apple 플랫폼의 음성 및 결정을 위한 개방형 모델
Apple.summary:
SpeakerDiarizer runs NVIDIA's Streaming Sortformer on Core ML alongside an Apple or Parakeet transcriber, on the same timeline: The diarizer tracks up to four speakers, even when they talk over each other.
Apple platforms already have an API for it. macOS 26 and iOS 26 introduced SpeechAnalyzer , Apple's new speech-to-text API.
Like image support in AnyLanguageModel, this goes beyond what Apple's API offers today.

A Starter plan with 10,000 AI credits costs $14.99/month, a Boost plan with 25,000 credits costs $29.99/month, and a Power plan with 50,000 credits costs $49.99/month.

Apple.titleEn: Apple Creator Studio update adds MotionVFX to Final Cut, and AI to everywhere - Engadget
Apple.titleKo: Apple Creator Studio 업데이트로 Final Cut에 MotionVFX, 모든 곳에 AI 추가 - Engadget
Apple.summary:
Apple Creator Studio costs $13 per month or $129 per year, and any new subscriber can try it out first with a one-month free trial.
There are plenty of other smaller quality-of-life additions for creators, like additional keyframe easing options in Final Cut Pro and the ability to isolate or swap out drum parts with the Stem Splitter in Logic Pro.
Some Final Cut Pro features require Apple silicon to work, and any Mac running the Apple Creator Studio version of the program needs to be running on macOS 26.6 or later.

Apple.summary:
Since it's mainly designed for productivity, Apple says the iMac is up to 50 percent faster for tasks like Microsoft Excel compared to the iMac M4, or 2.5x faster than the M1 model.
That processor, along with faster 170GB/s memory bandwidth, will make the iMac twice as fast for graphics performance compared to the previous iMac M4 model, accelerating intensive tasks like photo editing and gaming, Apple said.
Unlike the latest Mac Studio, it only supports Thunderbolt 4 rather than the two-times-faster Thunderbolt 5 connections, unfortunately.

Google DeepMind.title: How Gemini is helping students and teachers in the classroom
Google DeepMind.titleEn: How Gemini is helping students and teachers in the classroom
Google DeepMind.titleKo: Gemini가 교실에서 학생과 교사를 돕는 방법
Google DeepMind.summary:
Dive into new topics with immersive explorations in the Gemini app. 15 college students share their favorite Gemini features We’re sharing 3 tips to study smarter with Gemini Notebook.
When educators used Gemini to co-design lessons, they reported feeling more creative than usual in their teaching and planning (79% with Gemini vs. 30% without Gemini) — a shift that helped transform classroom dynamics.
Together, we learned from Primary, Secondary and Vocational educators across 1,600 teachers (representing over 24,500 students ages 13-18) by collecting classroom activities and self reports on lesson planning both with and without Gemini for Education to understand how AI supports classroom dynamics, student engagement, and teacher wellbeing.

Ad On Gray Swan's indirect prompt injection benchmark, Carbon pushed the attack success rate from 0.7 percent with Argon down to 0.0 percent, blocking every tested manipulation attempt according to Google.

Gemini 4 Carbon launches at the same introductory price as Argon: $2 per million input tokens and $10 per million output tokens, with cached input tokens getting a 95 percent discount off the regular input price.

Amazon.summary:
The gateway applies the organization’s guardrails (for example, Amazon Bedrock Guardrails or a third-party provider), restricts which models and inference AWS Regions each Workstream can use, and enforces per-Workstream rate limits, token quotas, and budgets so that no single team can exhaust shared capacity.

Amazon.summary:
Training completed in about 32 minutes on SageMaker serverless fine-tuning for roughly $20–$25.
They then expanded the training set to 86,281 rows by having Anthropic’s Claude Sonnet 4.6 on Amazon Bedrock rewrite the prose of each example while its labels and numeric fields stayed fixed.
The pipeline produces task-specific fine-tuned models for two deployment targets, edge and cloud, achieving higher accuracy than frontier models at up to 49× lower cost.

Amazon.title: Fix evaluation bias to unlock better models on Amazon Bedrock | Amazon Web Services
Amazon.titleEn: Fix evaluation bias to unlock better models on Amazon Bedrock | Amazon Web Services
Amazon.titleKo: Amazon Bedrock에서 더 나은 모델을 잠금 해제하기 위해 평가 편향 수정 | 아마존 웹 서비스
Amazon.summary:
The engineering team at Property Finder , a digital real estate application, discovered that 96.8 percent of their evaluation labels had been inherited directly from a single model’s predictions rather than verified by human experts.
In the remaining 3.2 percent of human-labeled samples, annotators had introduced categories outside the original specification, like Office appearing where no such label existed in the prompt.
In this post, we share how Property Finder identified evaluation bias, built unbiased ground truth, and applied evolutionary prompt optimization to select the right model on Amazon Bedrock, achieving higher accuracy at 86 percent lower cost.
summaryLinesEn: The engineering team at Property Finder , a digital real estate application, discovered that 96.8 percent of their evaluation labels had been inherited directly from a single model’s predictions rather than verified by human experts.
In the remaining 3.2 percent of human-labeled samples, annotators had introduced categories outside the original specification, like Office appearing where no such label existed in the prompt.

In this post, we share how Property Finder identified evaluation bias, built unbiased ground truth, and applied evolutionary prompt optimization to select the right model on Amazon Bedrock, achieving higher accuracy at 86 percent lower cost.
summaryLinesKo: 디지털 부동산 애플리케이션인 Property Finder의 엔지니어링 팀은 평가 라벨의 96.8%가 인간 전문가의 검증이 아닌 단일 모델의 예측에서 직접 상속되었다는 사실을 발견함
사람이 레이블을 지정한 나머지 3.2%의 샘플에서는 주석 작성자가 프롬프트에 해당 레이블이 없는 곳에 Office가 나타나는 것과 같이 원래 사양을 벗어난 범주를 도입함
이 게시물에서는 Property Finder가 어떻게 평가 편향을 식별하고, 편향되지 않은 실측 정보를 구축하고, 혁신적인 프롬프트 최적화를 적용하여 Amazon Bedrock에서 올바른 모델을 선택하여 86% 더 낮은 비용으로 더 높은 정확도를 달성했는지 공유함

As we show in the What we measured section, this reduced GPU idle time during image pulls by up to 90 percent in our benchmarks.

Anthropic.titleEn: Anthropic just launched tools to show companies what their AI spending is buying

Anthropic.summary:
The company recorded an operating profit in the second quarter, and 900% net revenue retention — that is, spending from the same customers in Q3 2025 grew nine times in Q3 2026.
More importantly, spending on those tools has grown 10x since the beginning of the year, with their cost now equal to about 2% of total engineering cost.
This is a clear attempt to demonstrate the return on investment of Anthropic’s tools and to show customers how to improve it — a major concern among large customers.

Anthropic.title: Claude discovers a novel enzyme system
Anthropic.titleEn: Claude discovers a novel enzyme system
Anthropic.summary:
After 21 hours spent searching this data by roughly 950 agents using 210 million tokens, one of the agents spotted something remarkable: a repeating pattern of DNA sequences that occurs next to the gene for an odd-looking RT.
Our research prior to joining Anthropic has helped to better understand the evolution and regulation of CRISPR systems, discover new enzymes for next-generation cell and gene therapies , and build tools for accelerating the identification of anomalies in DNA, such as human pathogenic variants.
We do research that involves only the lower levels of the biosafety risk level (BSL-1 and BSL-2) and we do not handle pathogens that can infect humans.

Our research prior to joining Anthropic has helped to better understand the evolution and regulation of CRISPR systems, discover new enzymes for next-generation cell and gene therapies , and build tools for accelerating the identification of anomalies in DNA, such as human pathogenic variants.
We do research that involves only the lower levels of the biosafety risk level (BSL-1 and BSL-2) and we do not handle pathogens that can infect humans.
summaryLinesKo: 약 950명의 에이전트가 2억 1천만 개의 토큰을 사용하여 이 데이터를 검색한 후 21시간 동안 에이전트 중 한 명이 주목할만한 사실을 발견함 · 이상하게 보이는 RT의 유전자 옆에서 발생하는 DNA 서열의 반복 패턴이었음
Anthropic에 합류하기 전 우리의 연구는 CRISPR 시스템의 진화와 규제를 더 잘 이해하고, 차세대 세포 및 유전자 치료를 위한 새로운 효소를 발견하고, 인간 병원성 변종과 같은 DNA의 변칙적 식별을 가속화하기 위한 도구를 구축하는 데 도움이 됨
우리는 낮은 수준의 생물안전 위험 수준(BSL-1 및 BSL-2)만을 포함하는 연구를 수행하며 인간을 감염시킬 수 있는 병원체는 취급하지 않음

Anthropic.title: Coding agents in the social sciences
Anthropic.titleEn: Coding agents in the social sciences
Anthropic.summary:
But Figure 4 shows that the most common use, for both coding agent users and others, is for coding up analysis of quantitative data: 97% of coding agent users and 77% of other AI users report using it to generate code.
The human sciences are shifting: for the first time, core research tasks can be handed off to machines.
These tools could accelerate science and make it more daring: fast research execution should mean cheap and plentiful discovery.

Anthropic.title: AI for Science expands to foundations and institutions
Anthropic.titleEn: AI for Science expands to foundations and institutions
Anthropic.titleKo: AI for Science는 재단 및 기관으로 확장됨
Anthropic.summary:
We started the AI for Science program in May 2025 with the belief that AI could significantly speed up scientific progress.
(Over the last few months, we’ve also launched our discounted Team plan for scientists and have supported hundreds of projects across biology, medicine, physics, chemistry, climate science, and mathematics.)
This $9 billion federal agency established by Congress in 1950 promotes the progress of science, advances national health and defense, and funds competitive research and education, accounting for about 25% of federal support for basic research at US colleges and universities.

OpenAI.titleEn: OpenAI launches GPT-6.1 Terra for faster, better performing AI agents at half the price - SiliconANGLE
OpenAI.titleKo: OpenAI, 절반 가격으로 더 빠르고 더 나은 성능의 AI 에이전트를 위한 GPT-6.1 Terra 출시 - SiliconANGLE
OpenAI.summary:
On the Terminal-Bench 4.0 test, which measures coding agents on tasks done through a computer’s command-line terminal, it solved 50.3% of all tasks when using maximum reasoning effort, up from 21.5% with GPT-5.6 Terra.
The new model is the successor to GTP-5.6 Terra and is said to cost around 50% less while handling computer use tasks faster and with greater accuracy.
GPT-6.1 Terra understands what’s on screen, takes action across apps, writes naturally, and is a more capable model for your whole workday with the efficiency to take on more of it. pic.twitter.com/8JTN1yonmV OpenAI said the model is available now for all ChatGPT Plus, Pro, Enterprise and Edu users in ChatGPT Work and Codex.

OpenAI.titleEn: GPT-6.1 Terra halves OpenAI's API prices and still gains ground on its larger models
OpenAI.titleKo: GPT-6.1 Terra는 OpenAI의 API 가격을 절반으로 낮추고 더 큰 모델에서 여전히 우위를 점하고 있음
OpenAI.summary:
Ad According to the system card , GPT-6.1 Terra holds up about as well as GPT-6 Astra and GPT-6.1 Sol against direct attacks on the instruction hierarchy , with those models hitting 99.99 percent on such tests.
Input tokens cost $1 per million, output tokens $5, compared to $2 and $10 for Claude Sonnet 5.5 and $2 and $12 for GPT-5.6 Terra.
On the scientific coding benchmark Terminal-Bench-Science 0.1, Terra outperforms GPT-6.1 Sol at lower cost and comes within five points of Claude Opus 5.5 at less than a fifth of the estimated cost.
summaryLinesEn: Ad According to the system card , GPT-6.1 Terra holds up about as well as GPT-6 Astra and GPT-6.1 Sol against direct attacks on the instruction hierarchy , with those models hitting 99.99 percent on such tests.
Input tokens cost $1 per million, output tokens $5, compared to $2 and $10 for Claude Sonnet 5.5 and $2 and $12 for GPT-5.6 Terra.
On the scientific coding benchmark Terminal-Bench-Science 0.1, Terra outperforms GPT-6.1 Sol at lower cost and comes within five points of Claude Opus 5.5 at less than a fifth of the estimated cost.
summaryLinesKo: 광고 시스템 카드에 따르면 GPT-6.1 Terra는 명령 계층 구조에 대한 직접 공격에 대해 GPT-6 Astra 및 GPT-6.1 Sol과 비슷한 수준을 유지하며 해당 모델은 해당 테스트에서 99.99%를 기록함
Claude Sonnet 5.5의 경우 2달러, 10달러, GPT-5.6 Terra의 경우 2달러, 12달러인 것과 비교하여 입력 토큰은 백만 달러당 1달러, 출력 토큰은 5달러임
과학 코딩 벤치마크 Terminal-Bench-Science 0.1에서 Terra는 저렴한 비용으로 GPT-6.1 Sol보다 성능이 뛰어나며 예상 비용의 5분의 1 미만으로 Claude Opus 5.5의 5점 이내임

OpenAI.summary:
Figure 2: Turn 1 saves the prompt prefix up to the breakpoint, and turn 2 reuses it and pays full price only for the new question For agentic workloads, implicit caching lets Bedrock choose what to cache as the conversation grows.
GPT-6 Astra tied for the best implicit result in this six-turn workload: about 62 percent lower input cost than running without caching.
Along the way, I show you how prompt caching keeps costs down and keeps agents responsive and consistent.

SpaceX.titleEn: Grok releases the first seven minutes of its AI-generated ‘Odyssey’
SpaceX.summary:
And Nolan is, in many ways, a perfect foil for Musk — while SpaceX and Tesla CEO hypes up data centers in space and posts an unending stream of AI-generated content, Nolan has described himself as “a techno-skeptic ” and said that before AI, he’d never seen a technology “so completely rejected by the public.”
Musk had previously lashed out at Christopher Nolan’s version of “The Odyssey” because Nolan cast nonwhite and transgender actors.
Three months after Elon Musk declared that Grok would release a full-length, “historically accurate” movie version of “The Odyssey,” Grok has published a whole seven minutes — what the company is now calling “Episode 1 of our Odyssey series.”

SpaceX.titleEn: Forced to pick, Grok’s AI model chooses Republicans. OpenAI’s picks Democrats.
SpaceX.titleKo: 선택을 강요받은 Grok의 AI 모델은 공화당원을 선택함 · OpenAI가 민주당을 선택함
SpaceX.summary:
A new study found that when forced to choose in this year’s upcoming midterm elections, SpaceXAI’s Grok 4.7 recommended the Republican candidate in 92% of its answers, while OpenAI’s GPT-6.1 Sol picked the Democrat in 97%.
Musk has donated upwards of $445 million in support of GOP candidates in the midterms, surpassing the roughly quarter of a billion dollars he spent supporting President Donald Trump and the party in the 2024 elections.
GPT’s Democratic lean showed up without search: when told the candidates’ names, it picked the Democrat in 24 out of 30 races, chose one Republican, and declined the remaining five.
summaryLinesEn: A new study found that when forced to choose in this year’s upcoming midterm elections, SpaceXAI’s Grok 4.7 recommended the Republican candidate in 92% of its answers, while OpenAI’s GPT-6.1 Sol picked the Democrat in 97%.

Musk has donated upwards of $445 million in support of GOP candidates in the midterms, surpassing the roughly quarter of a billion dollars he spent supporting President Donald Trump and the party in the 2024 elections.
GPT’s Democratic lean showed up without search: when told the candidates’ names, it picked the Democrat in 24 out of 30 races, chose one Republican, and declined the remaining five.

머스크는 중간선거에서 공화당 후보를 지원하기 위해 4억 4500만 달러 이상을 기부했는데, 이는 2024년 선거에서 도널드 트럼프 대통령과 당을 지원하기 위해 지출한 약 25억 달러를 넘어선 것임

Databricks.titleEn: How Procore is powering construction analytics with OpenSharing | Databricks Blog

Databricks.summary:
When a project manager, a construction executive thousands of miles away, and a superintendent on the jobsite can't see the same view of a project, decisions get made based on stale or partial information.
Doubled data availability for end customers and internal product teams, accelerating new product experiences and giving real estate facility owners, general contractors, and specialty contractors a single trusted view of every job.
Customers also need that data in their own environments, alongside everything else they run the business on (e.g. a general contractor pulling Procore data into Power BI to track workforce and personnel metrics across active jobs, or a customer joining it with their ERP and financial systems to see project execution and cost in one place).

최종 고객과 내부 제품 팀의 데이터 가용성을 두 배로 높이고, 새로운 제품 경험을 가속화하고, 부동산 시설 소유자, 일반 계약자, 전문 계약자에게 모든 작업에 대한 신뢰할 수 있는 단일 보기를 제공함
또한 고객은 비즈니스를 운영하는 다른 모든 것과 함께 자신의 환경에서 해당 데이터가 필요합니다(예 · 일반 계약업체가 Procore 데이터를 Power BI로 가져와 활성 작업 전반에 걸쳐 인력 및 인사 지표를 추적하거나 고객이 ERP 및 재무 시스템과 결합하여 프로젝트 실행 및 비용을 한 곳에서 확인하는 경우)

Databricks.summary:
Databricks Free Edition is a perpetually free version of the platform; each student signs up individually and works entirely in the browser, so a course can adopt it without provisioning servers or purchasing anything.
One platform can support an entire data + AI curriculum , from introductory data science and statistics through data engineering, BI, machine learning, AI, and capstone projects.
The barriers that often make industry platforms difficult to bring into the classroom, including cost, licensing, and IT provisioning, are solved by Databricks Free Edition; a permanently free account with no credit card, no cloud contract, and nothing to install.

Mistral AI.summary:
“Other labs have raised hundreds of billions to develop equivalent capabilities; in three years, Mistral raised roughly $6 billion.”
Open weights mean companies can take the model and deploy it on their own hardware, within their own firewalls, and run sensitive data without exposing it to the cloud or outside parties.
“Open source is essential to ensure state-of-the-art AI does not end up concentrated in the hands of a few actors,” said co-founder and Chief Executive Arthur Mensch.

If AI is destined to become a central feature of both cyber offense and defense, the argument goes, businesses and governments will need to be equipped with models that are freely available and cannot be switched off remotely, unlike proprietary models from the likes of OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google.

Sierra AI.title: 𝜏³-Bench: Advancing agent evaluation to knowledge and voice
Sierra AI.titleEn: 𝜏³-Bench: Advancing agent evaluation to knowledge and voice
Sierra AI.titleKo: 𝜏³-벤치 · 상담사 평가를 지식과 음성으로 발전
Sierra AI.summary:
The headline comparison is non‑reasoning text models versus voice agents in realistic conditions: under ideal conditions (no interruptions or audio effects) the best voice agents get close to non‑reasoning text models (~54% vs 31–51% clean voice), but once you introduce realistic audio and turn‑taking the gap widens substantially (~54% vs 26–38% realistic voice).
Voice agents need to handle all of this while still completing real tasks: looking up orders, updating accounts, booking flights.
To test this, 𝜏-Knowledge introduces 𝜏-Banking, a fintech-inspired customer support domain built around a realistic knowledge base of 698 documents across 21 product categories (~195K tokens).

Voice agents need to handle all of this while still completing real tasks: looking up orders, updating accounts, booking flights.
To test this, 𝜏-Knowledge introduces 𝜏-Banking, a fintech-inspired customer support domain built around a realistic knowledge base of 698 documents across 21 product categories (~195K tokens).
summaryLinesKo: 헤드라인 비교는 현실적인 조건의 비추리 텍스트 모델과 음성 에이전트임 · 이상적인 조건(중단 또는 오디오 효과 없음)에서는 최고의 음성 에이전트가 비추리 텍스트 모델에 가까워지지만(~54% 대 31~51% 깨끗한 음성), 일단 사실적인 오디오를 도입하고 차례대로 진행하면 격차가 상당히 넓어집니다(~54% 대 26~38% 사실적인 음성)
음성 에이전트는 주문 조회, 계정 업데이트, 항공편 예약 등 실제 작업을 완료하는 동시에 이 모든 것을 처리해야 함
이를 테스트하기 위해 𝜏-Knowledge는 21개 제품 카테고리(~195,000개 토큰)에 걸쳐 698개 문서의 현실적인 지식 기반을 기반으로 구축된 핀테크에서 영감을 받은 고객 지원 도메인인 𝜏-Banking을 도입함

Sierra AI.title: AI-pilling our company: lessons learned
Sierra AI.summary:
We set up a six-person AI acceleration team to find out.
So the bottleneck has moved to context: what’s specific to your company, your workflows, your history, the judgment calls that don’t show up in any training set.
We began with a group of role-specific agents: a support agent (PINE), a data analyst (Pinewood), an engineer (Pinecone), and a sales agent (Reggie Jr).

Sierra AI.title: AI-native product localization
Sierra AI.summary:
Sierra — 4 months, 2 initial locales (Spanish and Japanese) with 4 more to come While I still relied on native speakers, internal dogfooding, and human review for translation quality, language nuance, and overall UX correctness, fewer human eyes meant fewer Q&A catches — that’s a real tradeoff.
This improved throughput immediately, but introduced a new problem: tracking mistakes at scale.
Historically, with projects like this you need to divide work, synchronize migrations, coordinate reviews, and manage QA across teams.

Sierra AI.summary:
Ease of use: We wanted users spending their time on high-leverage decisions — not on figuring out how to be productive in a different system with different limitations.
Before Pinecone, it wasn’t unusual to see engineers walking around the office with half-open laptops — not because they were working, but because their AI agents were.
The stateful runner layer is where the agentic environment lives and is composed of all the on-demand pods created by the control plane.

Hugging Face.summary:
SpeakerDiarizer runs NVIDIA's Streaming Sortformer on Core ML alongside an Apple or Parakeet transcriber, on the same timeline: The diarizer tracks up to four speakers, even when they talk over each other.
Apple platforms already have an API for it. macOS 26 and iOS 26 introduced SpeechAnalyzer , Apple's new speech-to-text API.
Like image support in AnyLanguageModel, this goes beyond what Apple's API offers today.

Hugging Face.title: Announcing Project ProtoStar: Making Publicly Funded Science AI-Ready
Hugging Face.titleEn: Announcing Project ProtoStar: Making Publicly Funded Science AI-Ready
Hugging Face.titleKo: ProtoStar 프로젝트 발표 · 공공 자금을 지원받는 과학 AI 지원
Hugging Face.summary:
Today, we're announcing Project ProtoStar , an initiative to unlock the potential of publicly funded scientific research by making datasets, models, and code more accessible and reusable, particularly for AI-driven research.
Project ProtoStar aims to help close this gap by encouraging systematic sharing of publicly funded scientific artifacts in AI-ready formats, supported by open infrastructure and practical publishing guidance.
The resulting projects and lessons learned will help build a practical evidence base for making publicly funded science more accessible and useful.

summaryLinesKo: 오늘 우리는 특히 AI 기반 연구를 위해 데이터 세트, 모델 및 코드의 접근성과 재사용성을 높여 공공 자금 지원을 받는 과학 연구의 잠재력을 활용하기 위한 이니셔티브인 Project ProtoStar를 발표함
Project ProtoStar는 개방형 인프라와 실용적인 출판 지침을 통해 지원되는 AI 지원 형식의 공공 자금 지원 과학 유물의 체계적인 공유를 장려함으로써 이러한 격차를 줄이는 데 도움을 주는 것을 목표로 함

Hugging Face.title: NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Transcribe and Granary v2: Intelligent Multilingual Transcription You Can Prompt and Adapt
Hugging Face.titleEn: NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Transcribe and Granary v2: Intelligent Multilingual Transcription You Can Prompt and Adapt
Hugging Face.titleKo: NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Transcribe 및 Granary v2: 프롬프트하고 적응할 수 있는 지능형 다국어 전사
Hugging Face.summary:
NVIDIA models hold the top two spots on David AI’s multilingual diarization leaderboard : Nemotron 3.5 Transcribe posts the lowest overall diarization error rate (DER), 18.26% across 21 languages, followed by Nemotron 3 Diarization at 18.38%.
Granary v2’s multilingual data (available on Hugging Face and ModelScope ) and reusable curation pipeline, together with NeMo Speech fine-tuning tools , extend prompt-level control to training: developers can define the written form they need and adapt the model to the speech their applications encounter.
On AA-AgentTalk, the held-out voice-agent speech set that makes up 50% of the AA-WER index, Transcribe scores 1.8% WER, versus 2.3% for the next-best open-weight model.

Hugging Face.title: Can we trust LLMs to judge whether a research idea is novel?

Hugging Face.summary:
By comparison, Idea Novelty Checker, a literature-grounded retrieval and reranking pipeline, scored 0.642 at $30.66, while Sakana AI’s AI Scientist, whose novelty evaluator iteratively searches Semantic Scholar, scored 0.772 at $82.05.
We saw substantial shifts on the Human-Only dataset as well; the same change moved Claude Opus 4.6 accuracy by 21 points.
On the Human+Generated set, a simple Claude Opus 4.6 prompt using low reasoning and majority voting across three calls achieved 0.854 macro-F1 at a total evaluation cost of $2.59.

On audio-visual video understanding, it beats models up to 10.7B parameters, such as Qwen2.5-Omni-7B, on Daily-Omni, WorldSense, and AV-SpeakerBench.

Abridge.titleKo: Abridge 2026년 10월 릴리스 · 방문 주제, 평가 대시보드 등
Abridge.summary:
Conditions due for follow-up are in view before the visit starts, orders are staged before the patient leaves, and inpatient notes start from what the chart already holds.
This month, Visit Topics, In-Visit Orders, and Patient Visit Summary Editing with the Abridge Assistant help transform how clinicians prepare for a visit, capture orders throughout the conversation, and send patients home with a summary more easily tailored to them.
Much of the work that makes a visit or a hospital stay take longer than it should is reconstruction: keeping track of which conditions still need follow-up, entering orders after the patient has left, assembling an admission note from across the chart.

Writer.summary:

Research on author journal-choice behavior also found that prioritizing fit and speed of dissemination yields greater odds of acceptance at the first journal submitted to.
This is also a field intelligence tool: your sales reps need to know what AI engines say about your therapy, because that’s the conversation they’re walking into.

This integration has led to time savings of around 2,400 hours per month — significantly boosting productivity and employee satisfaction. 84% of employees and 96% of executives expect potential employers to provide generative AI training opportunities, and Qualcomm’s proactive approach has not only met but exceeded these expectations.

Writer.title: WRITER Gives Enterprises Control Over AI Detection with Invisible, Customer-Specific Watermarks
Writer.titleEn: WRITER Gives Enterprises Control Over AI Detection with Invisible, Customer-Specific Watermarks
Writer.titleKo: WRITER는 눈에 보이지 않는 고객별 워터마크를 통해 기업에 AI 탐지 제어 기능을 제공함
Writer.summary:
They want ownership, control, and configurability, right down to how and when their AI-generated content is watermarked,” said May Habib, CEO and Co-founder of WRITER.
WRITER’s watermarking approach builds on its commitment to put enterprises in control of their AI decisions and outputs SAN FRANCISCO — October 27, 2026 — WRITER , the leading AI platform for enterprise growth, today introduced a new approach to text watermarking that gives enterprises ownership, control and choice over how their AI-generated text is identified and traced.
When enterprises enable watermarking, text generated by WRITER’s Palmyra models will carry an invisible, machine-readable mark specific to each customer’s organization.

DeepSeek.title: DeepSeek 10B Yuan Financing Nears Completion: Partners with Perfect World, SMIC PES Capital & Industrial Capitals, Doubles Raised Funds to Bet Big on Embodied Intelligence
DeepSeek.titleEn: DeepSeek 10B Yuan Financing Nears Completion: Partners with Perfect World, SMIC PES Capital & Industrial Capitals, Doubles Raised Funds to Bet Big on Embodied Intelligence
DeepSeek.titleKo: DeepSeek 100억 위안 파이낸싱 완료 임박 · Perfect World, SMIC PES Capital & Industrial Capitals와 제휴, 구현된 지능에 크게 투자하기 위해 자금 조달 두 배 증가
DeepSeek.summary:
If the 100-billion-yuan scale of this round is added to the RMB 51 billion first-round financing finalized by Liang Wenfeng and core institutions at the end of June, DeepSeek has cumulatively absorbed more than RMB 1500 billion of capital in just over 100 days, setting a brand new record for capital throughput speed in the global artificial intelligence field .
In August this year, DeepSeek once launched a high-paying recruitment in the fields of game development and 3D rendering , which attracted widespread attention in the game industry.
Sources familiar with the matter revealed that the transaction underwent drastic dynamic adjustments during the promotion process: the initial planned fundraising amount was RMB 500 billion , then under the competition of industrial capital from all parties and existing shareholders, the target was raised twice , and the final financing amount directly doubled to the hundred-billion-yuan level .
